comment: v5.5 patches (after settings-v5.4.json): LAN room discovery for the room host (Android APK hot-update). ① server/index.js gains two READ-ONLY routes, GET /lan/rooms and GET /lan/room?code=, gated on the socket peer being loopback/private (reuses net.js isLocalIp/normalizeIp -- X-Forwarded-For / CF-Connecting-IP are never consulted, so a public request cannot masquerade as a LAN peer); a public peer and an unknown code share one identical 404 body, so the response never leaks whether a room exists. ② a second fixed-port listener (LAN_DISCOVERY_PORT = 32123) is started inside startServer() after the main listen, serving only those two routes, reusing one shared handler; it swallows EADDRINUSE (owner server must never fail to boot) and unref()s itself. Both additions live inside the startServer() call path only -- no module-top-level Node API is added, so the Cloudflare Workers build input is unaffected. Only server/index.js is modified.

patches.replace: import { Network, SessionRegistry, NET_DEFAULTS, isLocalIp, normalizeIp } from './net.js';

try { wss.close(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
      try { discoveryServer.close(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
